Create a high-resolution photorealistic game skin atlas for ARMAGON'S MECHANICAL LEGS. Image1 is the original low-resolution atlas and the absolute blueprint for all shapes, proportions, positions, colours and panel layout. Image2 is the owner's enhanced Enforcer and is ONLY a material quality reference: broad quiet metal surfaces, clear functional seams, restrained edge wear, believable industrial weight. Never copy its human anatomy, costume, colours or atlas layout.

Reconstruct clean continuous industrial surfaces; do not enlarge, sharpen or imitate the original pixel dithering. Keep the original DARK EARTHY BROWN and CHARCOAL metal, dark grey-brown steel edges and restrained dark red vent/stain accents. Preserve original tonal balance. Do not turn this into bright bronze, gold, silver, chrome or polished steampunk machinery. Large panels should remain visually quiet. Clear existing vents, functional joints, layered plates and feet give the design character. Add only subtle localized roughness, recessed machining lines and believable wear following original features, never uniform speckles, dense random rivets, crackle, sandpaper grain or embossed ornament.

STRICT PRODUCTION ATLAS: retain Image1's 228:194 composition and both SIDEWAYS halves, exactly the same native silhouettes, all small detached pieces, border fragments, gaps, foot shapes and orientation, panel boundaries and red details. No rotation upright, rearrangement, perspective, cropping or mirroring. This remains the original Armagon leg design, not a new robot. Flat pure black background, crisp clean boundaries, neutral even diffuse lighting. No character torso, new equipment, flames, cast shadow, scene, labels, text, border or watermark. Clean photographic detail like the owner's enhanced game art, fully resolved and smooth rather than pixelated or grainy.
